card.name: Straight dance
card.era: developed 20th c. from older war dances
card.tagline: Southern Plains Native American men's powwow dance — NOT Chinese
card.profile: The Straight Dance (Southern Straight / Southern Traditional) is a style of Native American powwow dancing from the Southern Plains tribes of Oklahoma, attributed to the Ponca Hethushka war society (English Wikipedia). A dignified 'gentleman's dance,' it recounts a hunting or war party tracking an enemy, using a measured toe-heel step danced clockwise. Regalia includes a ribbon shirt, otter dragger, roach headdress and beadwork.
card.insight: It is a formal, prestigious expression of Southern Plains warrior heritage that preserved war-society traditions after those societies dissolved (English Wikipedia; PowWows.com).
